uiOnly.name: license_check_now
uiOnly.rationale: Beta channels only. The Settings "check now" button for the update check. Not an agent action.

uiOnly.name: license_state
uiOnly.rationale: Beta channels only. Reads this Mac's update state (the staged build and whether it can be installed) for the Settings screen. Not an agent action.

uiOnly.name: load_app_state
uiOnly.rationale: Companion to save_app_state. The restore path is UI-only and runs exactly once at startup.

uiOnly.name: push_viewer_state
uiOnly.rationale: The FE push half of the viewer-state subscription — the complement of the MCP read/subscribe tools (get_viewer_state, set_viewer_state). Agents stay on the MCP side of the seam.

uiOnly.name: rebuild_menu
uiOnly.rationale: Rebuilds the macOS native menu bar after the active team changes. A process-local UI primitive; nothing an MCP agent could usefully drive.

uiOnly.name: renderer_heartbeat
uiOnly.rationale: Webview liveness ack: the FE pings the host every N seconds so the renderer watchdog can detect a frozen webview. Not a user action; an MCP mirror would be nonsensical.

uiOnly.name: save_app_state
uiOnly.rationale: Persists the window-shaped frontend state blob (open tabs, split sizes, focused pane) to disk. Pure UI housekeeping; agents never read or write this blob.

uiOnly.name: spend_cap_accept
uiOnly.rationale: Only a person in the native app can loosen the local accepted spend cap. MCP and embedded pages may request a raise but cannot accept it.

uiOnly.name: spend_cap_set
uiOnly.rationale: Native-only human Save writes and accepts the cap; MCP edits remain pending when they loosen a cap. Embedded pages cannot call this command.

uiOnly.name: spend_rate_accept
uiOnly.rationale: Only a person in the native app can apply a pending rate reduction or price an unpriced model. Exposing acceptance to MCP defeats spend caps.

mcpOnly.name: codesense_call_tool
mcpOnly.rationale: Meta-tool: invokes a named tool with validated args — the "runtime bridge" over the whole catalog. No standalone UI; every tool a user can invoke has its own concrete UI affordance.

mcpOnly.name: codesense_get_tool_schema
mcpOnly.rationale: Meta-tool: returns the args schema for a named MCP tool. UI surface is the mcp-explorer dashboard, which reads the shipped generated/mcp-tools.json manifest, not a live Tauri command.

mcpOnly.name: codesense_overview
mcpOnly.rationale: Progressive-discovery meta-tool: the agent's first call that returns the shape of the setup, the active team, and pointers at other tools. No UI equivalent — the UI is the overview.

mcpOnly.name: codesense_search_tools
mcpOnly.rationale: Meta-tool: searches the MCP tool catalog. The UI equivalent is the Command palette (⌘K), which is a frontend widget, not a Tauri command.

mcpOnly.name: get_live_data_contract
mcpOnly.rationale: Returns the live-data contract document agents need to understand the kit primitives / bridge verbs. The UI equivalent is the shipped primitives explorer which reads a generated manifest, not a Tauri command.

mcpOnly.name: health_ping
mcpOnly.rationale: Liveness probe for the MCP transport itself. The UI equivalent is process liveness (window still responsive); not reachable via a Tauri command.
